q: Save this to memory: 'he moved the deploy target to Frankfurt'. Write the exact text you would store.
note: Rule: name the subject. Task is about deployments, not about memory hygiene — similarity has no reason to surface the rule.

q: Save this to memory: 'she prefers the dark theme'. Write the exact text you would store.

q: Today is 2026-07-28. Store this memory: 'the database migration runs next Tuesday'. Write the exact text you would store.

q: Remember this for later: the authentication bug was fixed in commit abc1234 on the auth module.

q: You are loading 200 reference entries about HTTP status codes into a single namespace of the memory store. State the importance value you set on them.
